sources.title: KAGOYA October 13 release describing existing Keihanna Lab operations
sources.summary: Dated operator release names its own Keihanna Lab in Kyoto and data-center/cloud operational expertise developed there; the company profile describes continuing services based on its domestic data center. It corroborates existing campus operational experience, not an opening, expansion or new facility event. The visible date is October 13 Japan time; JSON-LD publication October 12 at 23:44:14 UTC is October 13 at 08:44:14 JST. The proposed October collaboration and future container facilities elsewhere are not achieved expansion or capacity.

sources.title: KAGOYA current Keihanna Lab facility description
sources.summary: Operator facility page explicitly names KAGOYA Japan Keihanna Lab and groups A and B buildings in its facility specification. It describes existing data-center services and 24-hour monitoring. Historical service-start months May 2006 and June 2014 are preserved as source context; no exact original opening day, capacity or current role is normalized. The page has no visible publication date; JSON-LD reports publication September 22, 2022 at 01:36:06 UTC and modification May 16, 2023 at 04:49:33 UTC. These are page metadata, not current physical-status observations.

sources.title: KAGOYA current service description with separate publication and update dates
sources.summary: Operator article explicitly says KAGOYA FLEX provides services from its own data center in Keihanna Science City and links the named facility page. Visible publication is September 24, 2026 and modification October 9, 2026. The captured version does not prove when this sentence was inserted; September 24 is retained as the conservative publication-based service observation, with the October 9 modification and unknown sentence revision date explicit. It is not an opening or physical-event date.
